get_code_expiration.name: get code expiration
get_code_expiration.description: Displays when to change the lockbox code next.

update_code.name: update code
update_code.description: Applies the next lockbox code and displays when to change it next.

set_code.name: set code
set_code.description: Updates the lockbox code to the given code.

set_code_expiration.name: set code expiration
set_code_expiration.description: Updates the code change reminder to happen on the given date. Date can be in any parsable format.

list_bands.name: list bands
list_bands.description: Lists the names of the bands recognized.

add_band.name: add band
add_band.description: Adds a band with the given name, role, and channel. Sends a greeting message to the band if parameter is not given or is "true".

rename_band.name: rename band
rename_band.description: Updates the name of the band with the given name to the new name.

remove_band.name: remove band
remove_band.description: Removes the band with the given name.

next_rehearsal.name: next rehearsal
next_rehearsal.description: Displays the details of the next rehearsal. Displays all with the same start time.

next_request.name: next request
next_request.description: Displays the details of the next gear request that is not a rehearsal. Displays all with the same start time.

refresh_calendar.name: refresh calendar
refresh_calendar.description: Manually updates gear requests from the calendar and reschedules gear request messages.

list_greetings.name: list greetings
list_greetings.description: Lists the greetings set for each category.

add_greeting.name: add greeting
add_greeting.description: Adds the given greeting to the given category of greetings. If not given, "general" is the default category.

remove_greeting.name: remove greeting
remove_greeting.description: Removes all instances of the greeting from the list of greetings.

list_farewells.name: list farewells
list_farewells.description: Lists the farewells set for each category.

add_farewell.name: add farewell
add_farewell.description: Adds the given farewell to the given category of farewells. If not given, "general" is the default category.

remove_farewell.name: remove farewell
remove_farewell.description: Removes all instances of the given farewell from the list of farewells.

add_thank_you_reply.name: add thank you reply
add_thank_you_reply.description: Adds the given thank you reply to the list of replies.

remove_thank_you_reply.name: remove thank you reply
remove_thank_you_reply.description: Removes all instances of the given thank you reply from the list of replies.

roll.name: roll
roll.params: <optional: size of dice> <optional: num of dice>
roll.description: Rolls the given number of dice of the given size. Default is a single d20.

list_settings.name: list settings
list_settings.description: Lists all settings and their current values.

set_setting.name: set setting
set_setting.description: Sets the setting with the given name to the given value.

list_commands.name: list commands
list_commands.description: Lists all commands and their usages.
